Flèches, ZQSD ou glisser à la souris : t: Arrows, ZQSD or mouse drag: turn · P or Esc: pause · space: play again. Each fruit lengthens the snake and makes it go faster; a star appears every 7 fruits (50 points, it doesn't stay long). Classic: edges kill · Without edges: we come out on the other side · Labyrinth: 4 walled plateaus, the next one every 10 fruits · Molt: every 5 fruits the tail turns into stone and the snake runs away · Chrono: 60 seconds, nothing kills, biting cuts off the tail · Orchards: three fruits on the board, ten species; the speed of the snake is that of the last fruit eaten (fast pepper, quiet blueberry), and slow fruits yield less. Records and statistics saved and synchronized.
Le jeu du serpent sur 24 × 24 cases, en: The snake game on a 24 × 24 board, in six modes: classic (the edges kill), no walls, a four-board maze, moult (the tail turns to stone every 5 fruits), a 60-second time attack where nothing kills, and orchards, where ten fruits each set their own speed and points. Bonus stars, a record per mode and synced statistics.
